#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

vector<double> cs, sn; // Precomputed roots of unity for FFT

void performFFT(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool invert) {
    int n = re.size();
    int shiftVal = 32 - (int)log2(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (int)reverseBits(i, shiftVal);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re[i], re[j]);
            swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        int wIdx = cs.size() / len;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < half; j++, k += wIdx) {
                double wRe = invert ? cs[k] : cs[k];
                double wIm = invert ? sn[k] : -sn[k];
                double uRe = re[i + j];
                double uIm = im[i + j];
                double vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm;
                double vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe;
                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe;
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm;
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe;
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm;
            }
        }
    }
    if (invert) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

unsigned int reverseBits(unsigned int num, int bits) {
    unsigned int reverse_num = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < bits; i++) {
        if ((num & (1 << i)))
            reverse_num |= 1 << (bits - 1 - i);
    }
    return reverse_num;
}

vector<int> multiplyModulo(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int length = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1 << (int)ceil(log2(length));
    vector<double> aRe(size, 0), aIm(size, 0);
    vector<double> bRe(size, 0), bIm(size, 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        int x = a[i] % mod;
        aRe[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aIm[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
        int x = b[i] % mod;
        bRe[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bIm[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    performFFT(aRe, aIm, false);
    performFFT(bRe, bIm, false);
    vector<double> aRe2(size, 0), aIm2(size, 0);
    vector<double> bRe2(size, 0), bIm2(size, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        double a1r = (aRe[i] + aRe[j]) / 2.0;
        double a1i = (aIm[i] - aIm[j]) / 2.0;
        double a2r = (aIm[i] + aIm[j]) / 2.0;
        double a2i = (aRe[j] - aRe[i]) / 2.0;
        double b1r = (bRe[i] + bRe[j]) / 2.0;
        double b1i = (bIm[i] - bIm[j]) / 2.0;
        double b2r = (bIm[i] + bIm[j]) / 2.0;
        double b2i = (bRe[j] - bRe[i]) / 2.0;
        aRe2[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        aIm2[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        bRe2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        bIm2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    performFFT(aRe2, aIm2, true);
    performFFT(bRe2, bIm2, true);
    vector<int> result(length, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        long long aa = round(aRe2[i]);
        long long bb = round(bRe2[i]);
        long long cc = round(aIm2[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((aa + (bb << 15) + (cc << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int modValue = 998244353;
    int totalN, totalK;
    cin >> totalN >> totalK;
    vector<int> freq(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < totalK; i++) {
        int digit;
        cin >> digit;
        freq[digit] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> base = {1};
    int halfN = totalN / 2;
    vector<int> current = base;
    while (halfN > 0) {
        if (halfN & 1) {
            current = multiplyModulo(current, freq, modValue);
        }
        freq = multiplyModulo(freq, freq, modValue);
        halfN >>= 1;
    }
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int val : current) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % modValue;
    }
    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
